trace.final:
Done. Summary:

**Diagnosis:** The latest release v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollback verified.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
